system.description:
When you **_study a situation or person_**, looking to the GM for insight, roll +WIS: **on a 10+**, ask the GM 3 questions from the list below; **on a 7-9**, ask 1; **either way**, take advantage on your next move to act on the answers

- What happened here recently
-What is about to happen?
What should I be on the lookout for?
What here is useful or valuable to me?
Who or what is really in control here?
What here is not what it appears to be?

success.value: ask the GM 3 questions from the list above

partial.value: ask the GM 1 question from the list above

failure.value: GM Move (**announce trouble, reveal an unwelcome truth, advance towards impending doom, use up their resources, turn their move back on them,** etc.)
